description: The bench record (MATCHING-DESIGN.md 3.7, D147, D188 to D191, D197; spec/metadata-keys.md "The bench record"): the line a node's memory probe of one enclave size signs with its probe key, its two time statements, the objects it writes to the integration bucket, the DP-request keys of the pb family the node agent appends after the cu keys, the line a validator rebuilds from them, the grammar of the readings field, the key sets that carry no record, the probe's inputs, session, key path and identity, and the members' bench checks with their placeholder figures and vectors. The network, node, validator and trustedzone record are capability-record.json's. Test keys only.
source: capability-record.json (network, node, validator, trustedzoneKey, metadata3 and metadata4 values)

measurement.n0Rule: keccak256 of the label "spec bench-record run nonce"; a probe draws 32 random bytes before the run
measurement.saltRule: keccak256 of the label "spec bench-record close salt"; a probe draws 32 random bytes after the region run and before it asks for the closing statement

grammar.entries: exactly five entries separated by ";", in the order heap, workers, encmem, custorage, epc, each key=value
grammar.heap: a digit 1-9, digits, then M or G: the probe's SCONE_HEAP
grammar.encmem: one of 1 2 4 8 16 32 64 (D150): the listed enclave size the probe ran at, GiB
grammar.epc: plain decimal, 1 to 2^31 - 1: the EPC claim proven, MiB (region plus allowance); an offer states at most floor(epc / 64) units
grammar.plainDecimal: "0" or a digit 1-9 followed by digits, ASCII only

readings.trustedzoneField: the trustedzone line's last field stays exactly heap=<h>;workers=<n> (capability-record.json); a bench field of two entries is refused

probeKey.note: test key only; stands for the key the network's CAS gives the probe of size encmem under that size's session, which admits the non-EDMM measurement alone

edmmProbeKey.note: test key only; stands for a key a session admitting the probe image's EDMM measurement would give: no reader takes it

signatureScheme: ECDSA secp384r1 over SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of line (no trailing newline), DER, lower-case hex without 0x, under the probe key of size encmem; the plain form whatever the trustedzones' statement form: the probe key signs no client text (reserved-prefixes.json lists etny-pb| so that no trustedzone key signs client text that begins with it)

probeEtny.layout: three LF-terminated lines: the bench line, its DER hex signature, an unsigned platform line

probeTimeEtny.layout: two LF-terminated lines: the opening (over n0) and the closing (over n1) GET /validator/time answers as JSON; the agent takes pbb0 and pbb1 from their block fields

metadata4.rule: appended after the cu keys of the same string (capability-record.json metadata4); pbgflops, pbcuv, pbworkers, pbencmem, pbstorage and pbepc decimal, pbheap as heap=, pbsig the DER hex without 0x

metadata3.rule: appended after the cu keys of the same string; pbval 0x+40 lower-case, pbn and pbs 0x+64, pbt0, pbt1, pbb0 and pbb1 decimal (the blocks from lines 1 and 2 of probe.time.<g>.etny), pbsig0 and pbsig1 0x+130

keyRules.orderFree: readers take the entries of metadata3 and metadata4 order-free, each up to its first =
keyRules.allKeys: a request carries a bench record only when all seventeen pb keys are present
keyRules.duplicates: a request in which any key of the pb family appears twice carries no bench record; one in which any key of the cu family appears twice carries no trustedzone record
keyRules.noAgentForm: a request with encmem=, custorage= or epc= in the cu family and no pb keys (the agent's form at 52e36e0) carries no bench record

lineFromMetadata.rule: a validator rebuilds etny-pb|v1|<baked chainId>:<baked pox>|<dproc lower-case>|<pbgflops>|<pbcuv>|<pbval>|<pbn>|<pbs>|<pbt0>|<pbt1>|<pbsig0>|<pbsig1>|heap=<pbheap>;workers=<pbworkers>;encmem=<pbencmem>;custorage=<pbstorage>;epc=<pbepc> and verifies pbsig over it under the probe key of size pbencmem

keySets.rule: the request carries the other sixteen keys and not pbgflops

keySets.name: without-pbcuv
keySets.rule: the request carries the other sixteen keys and not pbcuv

keySets.rule: the request carries the other sixteen keys and not pbsig

keySets.rule: the request carries the other sixteen keys and not pbheap

keySets.rule: the request carries the other sixteen keys and not pbworkers

keySets.rule: the request carries the other sixteen keys and not pbencmem

keySets.rule: the request carries the other sixteen keys and not pbstorage

keySets.name: without-pbepc
keySets.rule: the request carries the other sixteen keys and not pbepc

keySets.name: without-pbval
keySets.rule: the request carries the other sixteen keys and not pbval

keySets.rule: the request carries the other sixteen keys and not pbn

keySets.name: pb-key-twice
keySets.rule: pbepc written twice (a second, larger value after the first): a key of the pb family twice carries no bench record

keySets.name: cu-key-twice
keySets.rule: cugflops written twice: a key of the cu family twice carries no trustedzone record; the bench record stands, but a bench record proves nothing beside no trustedzone record (its share check reads cugflops)

keySets.name: keys-order-free
keySets.rule: the seventeen keys in another order, the pb keys of metadata4 before the cu keys: readers take keys order-free

inputs.bucketEnv: the integration bucket's .env: ETNY_NODE_ADDRESS (the node, lower-case into the line), ETNY_STORAGE_FREE_BYTES (free bytes of the task filesystem, plain decimal at most 2^63 - 1), ETNY_EPC_MIB (the claim, plain decimal 1 to 2^31 - 1)
inputs.hostWritten: the host writes all three; the node address is the only tie between the record and the node, and the members' time endpoint signs for any node and nonce

session.perSize: a SessionRegistry session per enclave size and network whose rules admit that size's non-EDMM probe measurement alone (OD17 A)

identity.measurement: ECImageRegistryV4 probeMrenclave(index, sizeGib) of a listed default release: the signed non-EDMM measurement of that size; a size-g measurement counts when probeMrenclave(i, g) equals it for some listed release i; the agent runs the probe of the newest release that lists its size
identity.edmm: the EDMM measurement of the same image is listed nowhere, admitted by no session and resolves to no key; the agent starts probes with EDMM off
identity.imageLocation: the probe image of each size is registered in ECImageRegistryV4's trustedzone table under a name per size with its compose (EDMM off, the memory limit); no member build's baked list of trustedzone names holds a probe name, so a probe name resolves to no record key
identity.writer: scripts/add-default-release.js lists a release with its executor and its non-EDMM probe measurements per size

platformBinding.rule: OD50 A: the member that admits a probe's CAS session records the DCAP quote's platform identity, and the node's trustedzone attestations must show the same identity; the field that carries it is not defined in this fixture
platformBinding.residual: until it is built a bench record is tied to its node by ETNY_NODE_ADDRESS alone, a host input, and the time endpoint signs for any node: one platform of a large EPC can produce bench records for many node addresses, and no check in an order re-measures the EPC

benchChecks.rule: a bench record is verified when, in this order: all seventeen pb keys are present and none twice (keys); the rebuilt line parses: tag etny-pb, version v1, fourteen fields, the readings grammar (line); pbsig verifies under the probe key of size pbencmem on the network, from the non-EDMM measurement, and under no trustedzone key (signature); node and PoX are the request's, which the rebuild bakes (node); pbsig0 and pbsig1 recover to a seated pbval over n0 = pbn and n1 = closeNonce(pbn, pbs, "<pbgflops>|<pbcuv>|<readings>") (statements); pbt1 >= pbt0 and pbb1 >= pbb0 (order); pbt1 - pbt0 at most the window bound of size pbencmem (windowBound); pbt1 within CU_TTL of the block timestamp (expiry); the claim leaves a region beside the allowance (region); the region's rate W / (pbt1 - pbt0) / 10^9, W the region run's fixed work below, at least shareMilli / 1000 x the cugflops of the request's verified trustedzone record (share) and at least the floor (floor); pbcuv at least CU_VERSION_MIN (cuv). No check reads the line's own GFLOPS, a figure of the enclave's clock, and 3.1's rate bound is not applied to it: the window holds the region's mapping, its touch and the reference run beside the strided run. A bench record that fails any check proves nothing: the offer is judged as one without a bench record (reasons 10 to 12 against 0); there is no reason of its own.

parameters.floorRule: the bench line names no instruction set, so a reader applies the lowest floor of the table
parameters.expiry: CU_TTL (ethernity-cas capability.rs CU_TTL_SECONDS, 7 days), the trustedzone record's: pbt1 at most CU_TTL from the block timestamp either way; each case is read at its readTime
parameters.status: placeholders to be calibrated on bare metal (OD16). The rig (EPC-B, S27): a true region's rate from the attested window 22.9 to 26.2 GFLOPS on etnyvm11 (AVX-512, a trustedzone record of about 125) and 8.3 on etny003 (SSE2); paged regions 4.0 to 6.1 (etnyvm11) and 5.7 (etny003); true windows 21 to 67 s, paged 90 to 138 s.

regionWork.rule: heapGib = ceil((encmem x 1024 + securelockHeapMib + trustedzoneHeapMib) / 1024); allowanceMib = epcAllowanceMib + versionArrayMibPerGib x heapGib; regionMib = epc - allowanceMib (no region below chunkMib); regionPages = regionMib x 2^20 / pageBytes; visits = max(epcPasses x regionPages, epcMinVisits); slices = max(1, min(epcSlices, floor(visits / regionPages))); rounds = ceil(visits / (slices x strideSegments x workers)); W = slices x rounds x workers x opsPerRound

cases.name: verified
cases.rule: the fixture's record: every check passes; the offer may state up to floor(1024 / 64) = 16 EPC units

cases.name: window-too-long-for-share
cases.rule: a window of 30 s: the region's rate from the attested window is 18 GFLOPS, below the share of 0.1 x 250

cases.name: below-floor
cases.rule: a trustedzone record of 50 GFLOPS (the share 5) and a window of 80 s: the rate 6.9 GFLOPS is below the floor of 7

cases.name: window-above-bound
cases.rule: a window of 81 s, above the bound of 80 s for 2 GiB (the rate 6.8 GFLOPS above the share of 0.1 x 50)

cases.name: edmm-key
cases.rule: signed by the key a session of the probe's EDMM measurement would give: it verifies under no listed probe key of size 2

cases.name: trustedzone-key
cases.rule: signed by a trustedzone key: a bench line verifies under the probe key alone

cases.name: expired
cases.rule: read 7 days and 1 second after pbt1, past CU_TTL

cases.name: no-region
cases.rule: an EPC claim of 22 MiB, which leaves no region beside the 22 MiB allowance of 2 GiB: no region work
